claim_groups.usable: Darai’s documented project follows a search. Its surviving papers, recordings and memories can support a new film without constituting a recovered print of the1936 work.

Credit Darai as filmmaker/project coordinator and Surya Deo as collaborator whose collected materials helped prompt the inquiry; performing artists are planned collaborators, not a confirmed named cast.
Distinguish the reported29March Calcutta screening from the28April1936 formal Puri opening.
A Kamapal Mishra play and Goswami’s rasalila practice offer specific stage connections. They do not make all Odia theatre forms direct ancestors of the film.
Identify Goswami by established film credit while acknowledging collaborative Calcutta production if needed; avoid claiming he alone financed, shot or directed every stage.
Historical accounts describe actor-sung songs; project gramophone traces must not automatically be identified with the film soundtrack.
A grandson reported unavailable prints in2011; IFA later documents a search. Neither supports claiming exhaustive archives checked, ownership resolved or recovery achieved.
Describe contemporary work as proposed docufiction: fictional enactments are its declared method, not newly authenticated1936 footage.

Her language background, sound training and documented use of imagined letters and puppeteer subjects provide specific context for the archival project. Keep biographical testimony and film descriptions distinct from our own viewing.
